---
title: "Gallery"
---

Moments from ATLAS students presenting their research across the country.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Drop any .jpg, .jpeg, .png, or .webp file into images/gallery/ and rebuild.
# Name files like this, using two underscores between the event and each person:
#   UPenn_MABC_2026__Arjun_Paunikar__Soham_Gupta.jpg
# The caption becomes "UPenn MABC 2026" with "Arjun Paunikar and Soham Gupta" below it.
photos <- list.files("images/gallery", pattern = "\\.(jpe?g|png|webp)$",
                     ignore.case = TRUE)
join_names <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(paste(x, collapse = ""))
  if (length(x) == 2) return(paste(x, collapse = " and "))
  paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", x[length(x)])
}
if (length(photos) == 0) {
  cat("Photos coming soon.")
} else {
  cat('<div class="gallery">')
  for (p in sort(photos)) {
    parts <- strsplit(tools::file_path_sans_ext(p), "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    parts <- gsub("_", " ", parts)
    event <- parts[1]
    names <- join_names(parts[-1])
    cat(sprintf('<figure><img src="images/gallery/%s" alt="%s" loading="lazy"><figcaption><strong>%s</strong>%s</figcaption></figure>',
                utils::URLencode(p), paste(event, names), event, names))
  }
  cat('</div>')
}
```
